description: Integration/staging monitoring for the local Besu QBFT private network.

panels.title: Dashboard Scope and Limitations
panels.description: Operational scope and semantic limits for this integration/staging dashboard.

options.content:
- The dashboard monitors the Besu QBFT integration/staging network.
- Block height is not evidence count.
- Chain-head transaction count is not cumulative transaction count.
- Peer count is not QBFT quorum.
- QBFT timer thread metrics are not validator-vote metrics.
- Grafana is not a blockchain explorer.
- Transaction correctness must be verified using transaction receipts, decoded events, and contract state.

panels.title: Network Overview
panels.description: Direct target availability and current network state.

panels.title: Besu Nodes Online
panels.description: Number of Besu Prometheus targets currently reachable. Unit: nodes. This is direct metrics availability, not blockchain consensus quorum.

panels.title: Validators Online
panels.description: Number of validator metrics endpoints reachable by Prometheus. Unit: validators. This does not directly prove participation in the current QBFT round.

panels.title: RPC Node Status
panels.description: Direct Prometheus scrape availability for the RPC node. Unit: state. UP confirms metrics reachability, not RPC transaction correctness.

panels.title: Current Block Height
panels.description: Highest block height directly reported by monitored nodes. Unit: blocks. Block height is not evidence count or transaction count.

panels.title: RPC Peer Count
panels.description: Direct P2P peers connected to the RPC node. Unit: peers. Peer count must not be interpreted as QBFT validator quorum.

panels.title: Synchronization Status
panels.description: Direct Besu synchronizer state for the RPC node. Unit: state. Live Besu 26.7.0 observation verified 1 as IN SYNC and 0 as NOT IN SYNC; this is not a QBFT quorum signal.

panels.title: Blockchain Activity
panels.description: Block progress and current transaction activity; no evidence totals are inferred.

panels.title: Block Height by Node
panels.description: Block height directly reported by each selected node. Unit: blocks. This is not evidence or transaction count.

panels.title: Block Production Rate
panels.description: Derived block-height increase over a rolling five-minute window. Unit: blocks/second. Startup and scrape gaps can affect the estimate.

panels.title: Estimated Average Block Interval
panels.description: Derived reciprocal of the five-minute block rate. Unit: seconds/block. A stall produces a very large value rather than a normal-looking interval; startup and scrape gaps can distort it.

panels.title: Transaction Pool Size
panels.description: Transactions directly reported as currently present in each selected node transaction pool. Unit: transactions; not a cumulative total.

panels.title: Transactions in Chain Head Block
panels.description: Transaction count directly reported for the current chain-head block. Unit: transactions/block. This is not a cumulative transaction or evidence total.

panels.title: Active RPC HTTP Connections
panels.description: Current HTTP RPC connections directly reported by the RPC node. Unit: connections. It does not count completed requests or transactions.

panels.title: Node Resources
panels.description: Direct Besu process and JVM resource telemetry.

panels.title: Resident Memory by Node
panels.description: Resident memory directly used by each Besu process. Unit: IEC bytes. This is process memory, not total host memory.

panels.title: JVM Memory Used
panels.description: Direct JVM memory usage split by node and memory area. Unit: IEC bytes. Heap and non-heap areas remain separate and are not summed.

panels.title: Process CPU Usage
panels.description: Derived average CPU cores consumed by each Besu process during five minutes. Unit: CPU cores. This is not host CPU percentage.

panels.title: JVM Thread Count
panels.description: Current JVM threads directly reported per Besu process. Unit: threads. It does not indicate transaction concurrency or QBFT votes.

panels.title: Open File Descriptors
panels.description: Open file descriptors directly reported by each Besu process. Unit: descriptors. Host-wide file usage is outside this metric.

panels.title: Garbage Collection Rate
panels.description: Derived garbage-collection event rate over five minutes by collector and node. Unit: collections/second. Short windows can be bursty.

panels.title: Garbage Collection Time
panels.description: Derived fraction of wall time spent in garbage collection over five minutes by collector and node. Unit: seconds/second; not total process pause time.

panels.title: Consensus and Network Health
panels.description: Inferred health indicators and direct connectivity telemetry; no direct quorum metric is available.

panels.title: Block Height Divergence
panels.description: Difference between highest and lowest block heights. Unit: blocks. This is an inferred synchronization indicator, not direct QBFT quorum telemetry.

panels.title: Peer Count by Node
panels.description: Direct peer connections reported by each selected node. Unit: peers. It does not directly represent validator quorum.

panels.title: Node Availability Timeline
panels.description: Direct Prometheus scrape availability by selected node. Unit: UP/DOWN state. Availability does not prove consensus participation.

panels.title: Block Production Stalled
panels.description: Inferred stall state from no RPC-node block-height increase during one minute. Unit: state. The window covers multiple five-second blocks and fifteen-second scrapes; this is not direct QBFT telemetry.

panels.title: QBFT Timer Executor Active Threads
panels.description: Direct internal executor thread activity associated with QBFT timers. Unit: threads. It does not indicate quorum, validator voting success, or consensus health.

panels.title: Monitoring Health
panels.description: Prometheus scrape state and existing memory-alert threshold visibility.

panels.title: Prometheus Target Scrape Status
panels.description: Current direct scrape status for each selected Besu target. Unit: binary state. It reports monitoring reachability only.

panels.title: JVM High Memory Alert State
panels.description: Derived state using the existing 1.5 GB resident-memory threshold. Unit: normal/high state. Sustained alerting remains governed by the Prometheus rule duration.
